title: Finite formal normalization for supplied parameter ideals
statement:
Let $(B,\mathfrak n)$ be a complete Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], let $e\geq0$, and consider either of the following cases. (a) $B$ is reduced, $\dim(B/\mathfrak q)=e$ for every minimal prime $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], and $\Lambda\hookrightarrow B$ is a coefficient field inducing $\Lambda\cong B/\mathfrak n$; let $b_1,\ldots,b_e\in\mathfrak n$ satisfy $\sqrt{(b_1,\ldots,b_e)B}=\mathfrak n$. (b) $B$ is a domain of dimension $e+1$, $\Lambda$ is a complete discrete valuation ring with uniformizer $\pi$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], and $\Lambda\hookrightarrow B$ is local and induces an isomorphism on residue fields; let $b_1,\ldots,b_e\in\mathfrak n$ satisfy $\sqrt{(\pi,b_1,\ldots,b_e)B}=\mathfrak n$. In either case the continuous evaluation map
$$\varphi:R=\Lambda[[T_1,\ldots,T_e]]\longrightarrow B,\qquad T_i\longmapsto b_i$$
[def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] is injective, local, induces an isomorphism on residue fields, and makes $B$ finite and torsion free as an $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. In case (a), writing $K=\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ and $L_{\mathfrak q}=\operatorname{Frac}(B/\mathfrak q)$, the canonical map is an isomorphism $B\otimes_RK\cong\prod_{\mathfrak q\text{ minimal}}L_{\mathfrak q}$, and every $L_{\mathfrak q}/K$ is finite [def-weil-module-base-change].
